ordinance_area_text: It shall be unlawful for any person to discharge any firearms or pneumatic gun in the county ... in or within 50 feet of the boundaries of any recorded subdivision ... Recorded subdivision. a. Any subdivision of property into two or more lots (i) which occurred after August 31, 1964; (ii) has a plat recorded in the county's circuit court clerk's office; and (iii) where the new lots created are to be used for residential or commercial purposes. b. The following subdivisions divided prior to August 31, 1964, as shown on the map titled James City County Pre-August 1964 Subdivisions Prohibited from Discharging Firearms, dated September 20, 2011: [57 named subdivisions] c. Any subdivision where two thirds of the lot owners have petitioned the board of supervisors to be included ... d. Recorded subdivision shall not include property divided pursuant to family subdivision, condemnation, or other board of supervisors' approved subdivision of property.
method: James City County GIS (property.jamescitycountyva.gov/arcgis/rest/services), queried with outSR=4326&f=geojson, paged. Union of: (1) JCC/GIS_Data/MapServer/18 'Subdivisions' (all 411 features except the 3 Prop_Type=Military entries: Camp Peary, Fort Eustis, US Naval Weapons Station); (2) JCC/GIS_Data/MapServer/19 'Sections' (recorded sections/phases; unnamed and military sections dropped); (3) for the 57 pre-Aug-1964 subdivisions named in the definition (b): the matching Subdivisions-layer polygon(s), plus current parcels (JCC_Historical_Research/MapServer/10, with SUBNAME and Legal1) whose legal description names the subdivision, plus parcels linked to the named plat in the county plat index (GIS_Data/MapServer/76 PlatLink, matched to current parcels by PIN); (4) small post-1964 subdivisions from the plat index: plats recorded after 1964-08-31 whose name indicates a subdivision/lots/section/phase (excluding family subdivisions, BLAs, easements, R/W, condos etc.), counting only lots (parcels <= 20 ha whose legal description is not 'ADJ ...', family, park, preserve, conservation or common area) and only plats with 2+ such lots. Union buffered outward 50 ft (15.24 m) in EPSG:26918, clipped to the Census 2023 cb_2023_us_county_500k polygon (FIPS 51095), holes < 2000 m2 filled, parts < 100 m2 dropped, simplified 2.5 m, rounded to 1e-5 deg. Scripts: scratchpad jcc/build.py.
notes: Result 148.3 km2 = 36.7% of the county incl. buffer (previous version: 130.3 km2, 32%; the county Subdivisions layer alone now gives 35.1%). Added vs layer alone: Sections layer ~1.1 km2, pre-1964 named-subdivision parcels ~0.5 km2, 125 small post-1964 subdivision plats ~4.2 km2. Still UNDER-inclusive: petitioned subdivisions (c) are not named in the ordinance and could not be identified; plat-index matching is by plat title only, so small subdivisions with uninformative titles (e.g. just an owner's name) are missed, and lots > 20 ha are deliberately left out. Possibly OVER-inclusive: plat titles do not say whether a division was a family subdivision (excluded by (d)) unless the title says so; some layer entries (Busch Gardens, Eastern State Hospital, JCC Riverfront Park campground, airport, Kingsmill resort) may not meet the legal definition but were kept as the cautious choice. Name matches: Rado Banks = Westbank Farms (plat 21-0025 'Westbank Farms - RADC L. Banks, Estate'); Yearda Lee Smith lots lie inside the 'Schulyer and Troy Smith' polygon; Washington Jones Estate parcels lie in 'Grove Area'; Thomas & Hattie Kearney = layer 'Tom and Hazel Kearney' + plat 56-110; D. Warren Marston = plat 06-0029 (1934); James Wesley Jones = plat 20-0025 (1962); Signor Bradby = plat 13-0009 (1952). Frank Anderson is TENTATIVE: matched to plat 29-0017 'Frank B Anderson Estate' (recorded 1972) near Whitehall, but parcels described 'adj Frank B Anderson' also sit in Norge. Both Steers entries map to the single layer polygon 'Steers' plus parcels whose legal description says Steers; which is Hickory Signpost vs Jamestown Road was not verified. Not found: Dandridge Davenport & Piggott (Dandridge/Davenport plats cluster near Glenwood Acres on Croaker Rd and a 'Piggott Town' parcel exists ~3 km east, but no plat by that name) and Levi & Lettie Wallace. The 2011 pre-1964 map was not found online. Not modeled: the 300 ft dwelling/commercial building/animal shelter rule, the 800 ft Colonial Heritage dwelling rule, and the 'ammunition crossing such areas' clause.
